data.narrative:
Slate Auto is a Series C-stage transportation company founded by Miles Arnone, Will Barker, and Jeff Wilke (former Worldwide Consumer CEO at Amazon). The company has raised $1.4B to date. The broader transportation sector comprises seven private peers, including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, ZeroAvia, and Harbinger; no direct public comparables exist at an equivalent stage or valuation tier.

Valuation analysis relies on the stage-progression method, as peer-median triangulation proved inapplicable. The transportation sector contains only three same-sector peers, none of which meet the threshold for narrow-set comparability (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier). The stage-progression approach applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier to the $1.4B total capital raised, treating that figure as a proxy for recent valuation. This yields an implied valuation of $2.4B.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $2.0B to $2.7B, with a median of $2.4B. The single-method foundation introduces material uncertainty; results should be stress-tested against market conditions, recent fundraising activity in frontier transportation, and company-specific unit economics or pathway-to-profitability milestones not reflected in this dataset. The reliance on stage-progression alone warrants caution pending access to additional comparable transactions or internal financial performance data.
